---
name: Bug report
about: Report incorrect results, errors, or unexpected behavior
---

## Reproduction

Provide a minimal Rust example and input. Include dimensions, cutoff, and whether
the input is coordinates or condensed dissimilarities. Avoid private data.

## Expected and actual behavior

For a mathematical mismatch, include the expected intervals or independent
calculation. Distinguish finite deaths from censored endpoints.

## Environment

Cocycle version or commit, `rustc -Vv`, operating system, and build profile.
For performance issues, include input size/structure, timing boundaries, and
resource limits.
